title: 2.2.1 Faba Bean (Vicia faba L.)
description: Faba bean: origin, requirements, planting, protection and harvesting

questions.question: What is the botanical name of faba bean?
Where is faba bean believed to have originated?
How did faba bean reach other parts of the world from its place of origin?
options: It originated in India and spread to Europe
It originated in Mexico and spread to Africa only
It originated in Ethiopia and was exported to Asia
It spread from the Mediterranean region to other parts of the world
questions.correctAnswer: It spread from the Mediterranean region to other parts of the world

questions.question: What is the main purpose of faba bean production?
How is faba bean used at the green stage?
At what altitude range does faba bean grow well?
options: Sea level to $1000$ m above sea level

questions.question: Which soil type is suitable for faba bean production?
options: Very sandy soils that hold no moisture

questions.question: How is faba bean planted?
options: Both by broadcasting and in rows
questions.correctAnswer: Both by broadcasting and in rows

questions.question: What spacing is used between rows when faba bean is planted in rows?
What spacing is used between plants of faba bean?
Which insect pests attack faba bean?
options: Maize stalk borer and army worm

questions.question: Besides insect pests, faba bean is also affected by which problems?
How often should hand weeding be carried out after planting faba bean?
options: Once in every $12$ weeks after planting
Twice in the first $6$ weeks after planting
Five times in the first $6$ weeks after planting
questions.correctAnswer: Twice in the first $6$ weeks after planting

questions.question: Which set of measures should be integrated to control faba bean weeds, pests and diseases?
options: Deep ploughing, seeding at night, drying and stacking
Fertilizer application, irrigation, staking and shading
Hand weeding, crop rotation, ensuring a clean seedbed and use of chemicals
questions.correctAnswer: Hand weeding, crop rotation, ensuring a clean seedbed and use of chemicals

questions.question: Why is crop rotation useful in faba bean production?
options: It makes the clay soil sandy
It removes the need for hand weeding completely
It raises the soil temperature for faster drying
It helps break the life cycle of pests and diseases and improves soil fertility
questions.correctAnswer: It helps break the life cycle of pests and diseases and improves soil fertility

questions.question: What is the first sign that faba bean is ready for harvest?
options: The seeds begin to germinate in the pod

questions.question: What colour change occurs in faba bean pods at maturity?
options: The pods stay green and become softer
The pods dry and change colour from black to green
The pods dry and change colour from green to black
The pods turn white and drop off
questions.correctAnswer: The pods dry and change colour from green to black

questions.question: At what stage should faba bean be harvested when it is grown for use as a vegetable?
options: At the green stage, when the pods are immature
After the pods turn black and dry
After the seeds have shattered from the pods
questions.correctAnswer: At the green stage, when the pods are immature

questions.question: What is the average national yield of faba bean in Ethiopia?
The national average faba bean yield of $19$ quintals per hectare equals how many tonnes per hectare?
Which group of Ethiopian field crops includes faba bean?
How is faba bean classified with regard to its cotyledons?
How does faba bean contribute to the nitrogen status of the soil?
options: It releases nitrogen into the air through the leaves
It absorbs nitrogen from the soil and stores it in the pods
It has no effect on soil nitrogen
It fixes atmospheric nitrogen into the soil through root nodules
questions.correctAnswer: It fixes atmospheric nitrogen into the soil through root nodules

questions.question: Which pulse crop can be planted mixed with faba bean?
In Ethiopia, pulses are mostly produced in which way?
options: With mineral fertilizer applied at every growth stage
With mineral fertilizer supplied only through irrigation water
